name: Long Beach Junior Lifeguards Cadet Program
what_you_do: Cadets get advanced first aid and rescue training. They shadow Long Beach lifeguards and help instructors. The goal is leadership and a path to lifeguard or other public service jobs.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 17. Must be at least 15 by July 1, 2027. Capped at 15 cadets.
pay_detail: Cost or pay is not stated on the page
duration: Summer; the 2026 cadet calendar is listed as not set
deadline_text: Tryout is listed for April 26 at 8:30 AM (year not stated; the age rule uses July 1, 2027). Interviews that day 11 AM to 3 PM.
how_to_apply: Sign up with the Cadet Tryouts Sign Up form on the page. Bring a resume. Pass a physical tryout: a 1000m open water swim in about 20 minutes and a run-swim-run in about 10 minutes. Then do an interview. Questions: LBJG@longbeach.gov.
notes: Very physical. Tryout date and calendar may change, so email to confirm. LBUSD students with at least one year of cadet experience can apply for a separate LBUSD Cadet Internship (details not on this page). The page header says the tryout date is not set but lists April 26.
